problems.symptom: Autonomous drift-commit activities commit untracked residue (drafts, tsc emit, probe files, {{placeholder}} paths, runtime jsonl, bun cache) into git
problems.root_cause: The drift-commit writer (vessel-code-commit-and-push / 'vessel code drift detected') has no source-vs-artifact filter. The pre-commit gate checks only top-level dirs, and a root tsconfig re-added by the substrate emits beside every .ts.

problems.symptom: A producer advertised a shape (httpResponse) but ignored its input, so the walk kept re-minting a replacement (12 orphan drafts)
problems.root_cause: Scaffold resolver left advertised. Law 3 composition with a lying producer returns garbage, and nothing detects that a shape's content is wrong while its status is fine.

problems.symptom: Retired UI vessel still running and co-producing uiPanel_write/uiQuestion_write; escalations go to the unread one
problems.root_cause: The cutover was never executed. A dark or duplicate producer reads as available (the design warned about this on 08-07), and 248 escalations went to :8270 (memory 09-22).

problems.symptom: The human surface cannot be authored by the substrate, then later has two diverging sources of truth
problems.root_cause: repos/human-surface-vessel is a plain in-tree dir, not a submodule, and the edit/cutover path assumes a submodule clone. The fix was a separate GitHub repo that the super-repo never references.

problems.symptom: Registry advertises 127.0.0.1 in-container addresses, so a lookup succeeds, the env fallback never fires and the result is a silent 502
problems.root_cause: Vessels register their in-container address. Callers pin env overrides instead of remapping via discovery, and the pins remain in the surface's config.ts and proxy.ts.

problems.symptom: Validators and instruments report success without observing: ui_legibility_scan success:true with available:false; vessel-ctl install ok:true over a failed build; readiness 'fleet ready' over a dead container; an early-exit harness reports a smaller, flattering denominator
problems.root_cause: There is no failure path distinct from 'could not observe'. Errors are swallowed with 2>/dev/null || true, and an empty state maps to skipped.

problems.symptom: Conformance checker and design-token contract built and proven, never wired into any lint or runtime probe
problems.root_cause: P5/P6/P10 false positives on well-factored code blocked wiring. Nobody owned the follow-up, and the openspec change was never archived and has no tasks.md.

problems.symptom: The vessel scaffold generates vessels that register partially invisible (nested resolverContract, no systemVessel)
problems.root_cause: Defect noted in BUILD-REPORT and never filed or fixed. No activity resolves the scaffold's own output against the registry.

problems.symptom: A staged-not-landed rolled-back draft left an uncommitted edit in substrate-live's worktree, blocking git pull --ff-only silently
problems.root_cause: Rollback of an UNFAVORABLE compose did not restore the working tree, and nothing reports a failure to converge to origin/dev.

problems.symptom: openspec tasks.md checkboxes do not reflect status (causal-attempt-ledger 0/36 while accepted); human-surface-stack never archived
problems.root_cause: No reader keeps tasks.md in sync with landed work. Status lives in prose headers and memory files.

problems.symptom: Duplicate mints and duplicate applies: 4010 activity rows but only 1909 distinct names; 3 identical-subject substrate commits in the surface clone on 09-22
problems.root_cause: Gap-closing re-mints under new auto ids per gap child, and retries double-apply landed edits (also noted in memory 09-25).

problems.symptom: The surface can be steered but does not learn: one render arm, no posterior, surfaceIntent not an activity
problems.root_cause: No counterfactual arm and no reward computed (time-to-verdict). A behavior that exists only as a resolver is invisible to Thompson (law 2).

principles: A validator must be able to fail: 'could not observe' must differ from 'observed nothing'. A blind detector that reports success is worse than a dark one (render-learning s6).
A gate must be proven to refuse on real code, not just on its own fixtures. A gate that fires on well-factored code trains reflexive exemptions and gets switched off (BUILD-REPORT s6b).
Retire completely: a vessel left dark or co-producing reads as available. That warning (08-07) predicted the 248 unanswered escalations.
Steerable is not learning. Learning needs a second arm and a reward; the reward is time-to-verdict, never dwell or volume.
The substrate answers about its own tree, not the operator's: say whose filesystem an answer describes.
A drift-commit that commits whatever is untracked turns every abandoned draft and probe into permanent tracked residue. The source/artifact filter belongs at the writer.
openspec tasks.md checkboxes are not status. Verify against landed code and acceptance evidence.
A negative needs a positive control through the same address: the legibility executions were absent from activity_execution_traces but present in execution.
